statement.p: What is the exact radian angle measure for 22^{\circ} as a fraction of \pi? radians
What is a decimal approximation for the radian angle measure for 22^{\circ} accurate to three decimal places? radians

static.solution:
SOLUTION
To convert 22^{\circ} to radians, multiply by \pi/180^{\circ}:
\displaystyle 22^{\circ} \cdot \left( \frac{\pi}{180^{\circ}} \right) = \frac{22 \pi}{180}
Thus we say that the radian measure of a 22^{\circ} angle is \frac{22 \pi}{180} which is approximately 0.383972 radians.
